title: Nutty Australian Lentil Bowl
description: A savory, nutty lentil bowl with a hint of cinnamon, cooked in a ttukbaegi and served on a talavera plate for a satisfying solo dinner.
instructions: Rinse 1 cup dried lentils under cold water until clear.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a ttukbaegi over medium heat.
Add 1 diced onion and 2 minced garlic cloves and sauté until translucent.
Stir in 1 cup vegetable broth, 1 cup lentils, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/8 tsp pepper.
Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce heat and cover; simmer for 15 minutes until lentils are tender.
While the lentils cook, toast 1/4 cup sliced almonds and 2 tbsp pumpkin seeds in a dry pan until fragrant.
Once the lentils are cooked, fold in 1 cup chopped spinach, grated carrot, toasted almonds, and pumpkin seeds.
Serve the mixture on a talavera plate, garnish with fresh cilantro if desired.
